name: AndroidWorld
intro: AndroidWorld 在固定版本的 20 个 Android 应用与 Pixel 6 / Android 13 环境上提供 116 个动态 TaskEval 模板。6 名标注员逐项执行任务、记录步骤与难度，并促成 30 多个缺陷修复；评测按独立随机种子实例化任务，经观察-动作循环后从持久设备状态计算奖励并检查鲁棒性。
build_method: 固定应用与设备版本, 116 个 TaskEval 动态模板, 6 人执行标注与缺陷修复
metric: 任务成功率, 跨随机种子与参数鲁棒性
eval_feature: 在线环境交互, 持久功能奖励, 参数化变体, 可复现设备状态
scale: 20个应用中的116个任务模板，可生成数百万参数化实例
build_method_en: Version-pinned apps and device, 116 dynamic TaskEval templates, six-person execution annotation and bug fixing
eval_feature_en: Online environment interaction, durable functional rewards, parameterized variants, reproducible device state
intro_en: AndroidWorld provides 116 dynamic TaskEval templates over 20 version-pinned Android apps and a fixed Pixel 6 / Android 13 environment. Six annotators execute every task, record steps and difficulty, and drive fixes for more than 30 bugs; evaluation instantiates an independent seed, runs the observation-action loop, computes reward from durable device state, and measures robustness.
scale_en: 116 task templates across 20 apps, yielding millions of parameterized instances
metric_en: Task success rate, robustness across seeds and parameterizations
drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with AndroidWorld arXiv:2405.14573v5 Sections 3.2-3.5, Sections 4-5, Appendix D, and official repository snapshot 3e508.... The corrected construction chain fixes 20 apps and their versions before implementing 116 TaskEval templates, then records six-annotator execution and 30+ bug fixes before the dynamic release. The evaluation chain is independent and seeded: instantiate, observe and act, compute durable-state reward, and measure robustness.
